intro: Socios can ask to use your mini apps for you, one task at a time, and only apps you can open yourself. You decide on a card in the chat. Changing data and taking actions always wait for you.

reading.title: Reading without asking
reading.help: For each socio, whether it may read apps for you without a card. Only you can choose this. Apps that ask every time still ask.
reading.label: Whether {{socio}} may read apps for you without asking

granted.title: Access you granted
granted.none: No socio can use an app for you now.
